_comment: Central look of the battle map (Phase 1, B3). Override any key in <data-root>/config/map-style.json. 'active' names the style the display uses; 'neutral' needs no pictures (drawn in the browser).

rules.perspective: top-down, straight from above, no tilt, no isometric view
rules.light: soft light from the upper left (north-west); shadows fall to the lower right
rules.readability: every square stays readable: high contrast between floor and obstacles, figures always on top, no clutter on walkable squares
forbidden: text, letters or numbers in pictures
people or creatures in floor textures

neutral.name: Neutral (Platzhalter)
neutral.description: Drawn in the browser, muted colours, no pictures needed. Used until a style is chosen.
